seed_policy: fixed labels are shared by methods; streams are independent by role

streams.dataset: dataset seed is recorded per task and never reused as search state
streams.split: split seed is recorded per task and fixed before method runs
streams.noise: noise seed is independent of dataset, split, and search seeds
streams.restart: restart count is part of the resource budget

pilot_seed_amendment: 2026-09-26: previous pilot labels overlapped formal seeds; retain old pilot artifacts but use disjoint seeds for adapter validation and calibration.
